summary: Iter 21 Phase 6C.1 Direct Messaging — 23/23 backend tests PASS in test_iter21_dm.py. All DM REST endpoints verified: POST /api/dm/threads (idempotent open, sender==recipient 400, recipient not found 404, pending status when recipient research-only with accepts=false), GET/PUT /api/me/dm/preferences (community=true vendor=false defaults confirmed, Elena research=false confirmed, toggle updates profiles_updated count), POST /threads/{id}/messages (403 while pending for sender, recipient reply auto-flips to active), POST /accept (only recipient), /block, /archive (removes from inbox), /flag (reason min_length=3 enforced via 422, sets ombudsman_flagged=true), /read (zeros unread + adds to read_by). Admin: GET /admin/dm/threads masks last_message_preview as '[hidden — not flagged]' for unflagged rows; GET /admin/dm/threads/{id} returns messages=null+bodies_locked=true when unflagged and full messages list when flagged; non-admin gets 401/403. All 5 iter18-20 regression endpoints PASS (disbursement-settings, admin/subscriptions, me/bookmarks, shares/log, workshops/{id}/ics). Frontend verified via Playwright: /dashboard/messages inbox renders thread row with RESEARCH partner_type label + FLAGGED badge + unread badge '1', thread detail renders bubble alignment (own=right teal, other=left white) with 4 messages, composer + Send button functional, Flag/Archive buttons in header, ?to=<user_id> deep link auto-opens existing thread (idempotent), DmPreferencesCard renders on /dashboard/partner with 'Accept new DMs' button (paused state correct), user menu dropdown contains Messages + Bookmarks links, MessageButton renders on /partners directory, ShareButton 'To a partner' menu item appears for logged-in user. No critical bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/dm.py _recipient_accepts has subtle precedence: when accepts_new_dms is None it falls through to the partner_type-default branch but does NOT short-circuit return on True for non-fac/community types — instead it loops; when accepts_new_dms is True it short-circuits return True. End result is correct for current types but consider explicit per-type default lookup table for clarity.

routers/dm.py _recipient_accepts: 'If no partner profile, fall back to True' means a sender (partner) can open thread to any non-partner user as active — matches spec (admins, regular users always accept). Good.

routers/dm.py open_thread idempotency: re-opening an ARCHIVED thread returns it with status='archived'. The frontend Messages.jsx doesn't have a special UI affordance to un-archive — currently archived threads are filtered from inbox listing but if a user navigates via deep-link or MessageButton again, they hit the archived thread and cannot send (status != 'active' silently disables composer). Consider auto-reactivating archived threads on re-open, or surface 'This thread was archived — reactivate?' UI.
routers/dm.py send_message — when pending and recipient posts, status flips to 'active' via a single update_one. Good. No race condition guard but unlikely under realistic load.

routers/dm.py block_thread checks initiator_id == user but error message says 'Only the recipient can block' — semantically clean. However the BLOCK endpoint never validates thread.status, so a recipient can block an already-archived thread. Low-impact but worth a status guard.
routers/dm.py flag_thread allows any participant (initiator or recipient) to flag — correct per spec.
routers/dm.py WS dm_ws: REST persistence is the source of truth, WS only broadcasts. Good separation. Typing events broadcast without rate-limit; consider throttling if abuse seen.
routers/dm.py admin endpoints correctly write audit log entries (dm.flag, dm.admin_view) with metadata.

frontend Messages.jsx ?to= deep link is idempotent — correct. But if user passes ?initial=<text> on a re-open of an EXISTING active thread, initial_message is silently dropped (open_thread only posts initial_message when creating new thread OR when thread is active and initial_message provided — see line 156-160 of dm.py). Actually it DOES post on existing+active — verified. Good.
frontend uses bubble alignment own=right + teal/white as specified — verified in screenshot.
